title: Fail-Safe and human obsolescence

tellings.quote: it's based on a novel um failafe. Okay. And I think it was originally made in like 196364.

plain: The philosopher James Madden tells Michels about Fail-Safe, a film based on a novel of the same name, which he dates to around 1963 or 1964. He ties the story to the philosopher Günther Anders's idea that humans are becoming obsolete beside the machines they build. He brings it up as an early warning about people losing control to their own technology.
